segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ עַזּוּת, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁעָבַר עֲבֵרָה לְהַכְעִיס.
segments.en: Through that which you take advice from the official rabbi, through this you will merit salvation.
When you see that your friends are not helping you, it is known that no advice  (or remedy)  will help you.

segments.he:
ג.

עַל־יְדֵי עַזּוּת לֹא יְקַבֵּל מוּסָר.
segments.en: When you help the Jewish People, advice can help you.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל־יְדֵי עַזּוּת  נַעֲשָׂה  אַבִּיר־לֵב, גַּם בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא תִּקֵּן פִּשְׁעֵי אָבִיו.
segments.en: Advice is more auspicious  ( segulah )  in a field.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶּׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַזּוּת, תִּקּוּנוֹ – שֶׁיַּנִּיחַ תְּפִלִּין, שֶׁהָיוּ עַל רֹאשׁ צַדִּיק.
segments.en: One who follows the advice of his wife falls into Hell.

segments.he:
ו.

כְּשֶׁרָשָׁע מֵעֵז בִּפְנֵי יָשָׁר, אֵין זֶה אֶלָּא כְּדֵי שֶׁהַיָּשָׁר יְפַשְׁפֵּשׁ בְּמַעֲשָׂיו.
segments.en: Do not ask advice; only from a man, and not from a woman.

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַזּוּת, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִסְתַּפֵּק בְּמַה שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ.
segments.en: One who is brazen, it is certain that he has transgressed out of spite.

segments.he:
ט.

עַל־יְדֵי עַזּוּת גְּשָׁמִים נֶעֱצָרִים, וּבְיָדוּעַ שֶׁנִּכְשַׁל בַּעֲבֵרָה, וְסוֹפוֹ שֶׁיִּכָּשֵׁל בַּעֲבֵרָה, וּמֻתָּר לִקְרוֹתוֹ רָשָׁע, וּמֻתָּר לִשְׂנֹאתוֹ, וְהוּא אֶחָד מתתקע"ד [מֵהַתְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה] דּוֹרוֹת.
segments.en: Through brazenness, one will not accept  Mussar (ethical criticism) .

segments.he:
י.

חֻצְפָּה אֲפִלּוּ כְּלַפֵּי שְׁמַיָּא מְהַנֵּי, וְהוּא מַלְכוּתָא בְּלָא תַּגָּא.
segments.en: Through brazenness, one’s heart becomes armored and it is also certain that he has yet to repair the sins of his father.
One who is brazen, his rectification is to don  T efillin (phylacteries)  that had been on the head of a  Tzaddik .

segments.he:
א.

כְּשֶׁרוֹאִין שֶׁהָעוֹלָם מְעִיזִין פְּנֵיהֶם כְּנֶגֶד הַתַּלְמִיד ֵי ־ ח ֲ כָ מִי ם, יֵדְעוּ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי מִלְחָמוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת יִתְעוֹרְרוּ עַל מְדִינָה הַזֹּאת.
segments.en: When an evildoer acts brazenly before an upright man, this is only so that the upright one will examine his deeds.

segments.he:
ב.

כְּאֵב הָרֹאשׁ בָּא עַל שֶׁמֵעֵז פָּנָיו כְּנֶגֶד זֶרַע דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ.
segments.en: One who is brazen, assuredly he is not making do with what he has.
The Torah is a rectification for brazenness.

Through brazenness, rains are withheld. And it is certain that he stumbled in a sin and, in the end, will stumble in more sin. It is permitted to call him "wicked", and it is permitted to hate him, and he is from one of the 974 generations .  [that were to precede the giving of the Torah, but because H”Y understood that the world couldn't manage that long without the Torah so he spread those generations throughout the rest of history] .
Audacity, even against Heaven, is effective, but it is considered as ruling without a crown  (i.e. illegitimately) .
1 When one sees everyone  (behaving)  brazen-faced to the Torah scholars, it is certain that great wars will be aroused against the nations.
Headaches come upon one who is brazen to the face of someone from the seed of King David.
